user.title: 4HEAT Lite Stove
user.description:
Enter the details from your 4HEAT WiFi module label.

Cloud sync requires a DNS override and firewall DNAT rule on your router. See [Cloud API Proxy](https://github.com/pafernanr/homeassistant-4heatlite#cloud-api-proxy) for setup instructions.

cloud.title: 4HEAT Cloud Credentials
cloud.description: Enter your 4HEAT account credentials (same as the mobile app). Used once to retrieve the DeviceKey from the cloud — credentials are not stored.

error.cannot_connect: Cannot connect to module. Verify IP and that stove is powered on.
error.device_not_found: Device not found in your 4HEAT account.
error.no_device_key: Could not retrieve DeviceKey. Ensure the stove has connected to the cloud at least once.

init.description: Cloud sync requires a DNS override and firewall DNAT rule on your router. See [Cloud API Proxy](https://github.com/pafernanr/homeassistant-4heatlite#cloud-api-proxy) for setup instructions.
